subject.title: docs: clarify ClawSweeper review and proof flow

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this exact proof-placement and automatic-review-trigger wording as root repository policy now?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but only an OpenClaw policy owner can confirm that the documented cross-repository ClawSweeper event contract is the intended durable contributor workflow.

options.title: Accept after dispatcher confirmation
options.body: Refresh onto current `main`, confirm the listed automatic events against the deployed dispatcher, and merge the documentation if they still match.

options.title: Narrow the trigger wording
options.body: If deployment semantics differ, retain the proof guidance but describe automatic review triggers more generally rather than enumerating events.

recommendation.title: Accept after dispatcher confirmation
recommendation.body: Refresh onto current `main`, confirm the listed automatic events against the deployed dispatcher, and merge the documentation if they still match.

likelyOwner.reason: The change modifies root contributor and agent policy, and the contributor guide identifies steipete as the project's lead maintainer.
